content.title: Ally Financial (NYSE:ALLY) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q4 CY2025 Earnings
content.summary: Digital banking company Ally Financial (NYSE:ALLY) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025 as sales only rose 1.7% year on year to $2.12 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.09 per share was 6.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Trump in Davos, SCOTUS hearing, J&J earnings: What to Watch
